name: linstor
description: LINSTOR / DRBD operations bundle for Kubernetes. Skills, invoked as linstor:<name>: recover (diagnose and recover broken DRBD resources — handles StandAlone, DELETING, Inconsistent, Diskless, quorum loss, bitmap errors, and other common failure modes). Useful on any Kubernetes cluster that runs piraeus-operator / LINSTOR, not just on Cozystack.
